notes.title: Chuzzo 1.1
notes.content:
Welcome to Chuzzo 1.1!

[list]
[*] Players can now reset the current board by pressing "S". Use this if your pucks become stuck! Please be aware that there is a 15 second cooldown timer to prevent spam restarting.
[*] Players can now mute the music while retaining the SFX by pressing "N".
[/list]

Thank you!

notes.title: Chuzzo Launch Day!
notes.content:
Chuzzo has released! Thanks to everyone that has played. We hope you enjoy your time in the game.

[u][b]Known Issue[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Pucks have a low chance to get stuck. We will have a fix for this soon, please restart your game to continue playing for now.
[/list]
[u][b]What's Next[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Bug fixes and game improvements. More info at a later date!
[/list]
